thread:
talia (CS): Heads-up — we have ~12 new onboarding tenants that hit webhook failures during provisioning between 09:12–09:28 UTC. Customers see a stuck "waiting for callback" state and onboarding didn't complete. I need aligned external wording + office hours for live help.
kevin (ENG): Investigating. Short summary: during a cert rotation a validation check incorrectly rejected some webhook handshakes (401). We reverted the rotation and applied a targeted hotfix at 09:35 UTC. Still reconciling a backlog of callbacks.
kevin (ENG): TL;DR: root cause = cert validation mismatch on outbound webhook TLS; mitigation = revert + retry infra; longer-term fix tracked in ENG-3842.
talia (CS): Thanks. Can you draft a single-customer-facing status message we can send? Also need a list of impacted tenant IDs and whether any have renewal conversations in next 30d.
kevin (ENG): Suggested external blurb: "We experienced intermittent webhook validation failures impacting onboarding callbacks for a small set of new tenants between 09:12–09:35 UTC. A fix was deployed and we are retrying pending callbacks; most onboards have completed. We apologize for the disruption — our team will follow up if any manual steps are needed. For live help, we’re offering prioritized office hours and a live troubleshooting session." Use verbatim if helpful.
maria (CS): I recommend segmentation: (1) high-touch/renewal at-risk accounts — phone + dedicated session, (2) mid-tier — email + invite to office hours, (3) self-serve — in-product banner + support doc. Offer: 1 month credit for affected onboarding window + 2 hours of enablement for high-touch.
jen (SALES): Please flag any accounts in renewal window. I have three at-risk deals; will loop legal/AE if we need commitment credits. Also share the list of impacted tenant IDs when available.
sam (PLATFORM): Operational note: to requeue callbacks run:```./tools/retry-webhooks --tenant $TENANT_ID --since 2024-06-03T09:00Z``` verify with:```curl -I https://callback.example.com/health -H 'X-Req-Test: 1'``` I requeued ~8 tenants already; include me in any manual retries.
ops-bot: Deploy 1717500235: hotfix/revert-cert-rotation applied by @kevin — status: success.
kevin (ENG): Postmortem ETA: draft RCA within 48 hours, final RCA + follow-ups in 5 business days. We'll include a list of impacted tenants and a mitigation plan for future rotations.
talia (CS): Plan for outreach: 1) Send high-touch email + immediate call invites (target within 2 hours). 2) Mid-tier email template and office hours link. 3) Post in-product banner for self-serve tenants pointing to support doc and survey. Draft templates I'll post here in 20m.
maria (CS): Proposed office hours: Today 16:00 UTC and tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll host the first one and @sam will join for retries. cc @jen for AEs to join.
jen (SALES): I can join 16:00 UTC for the accounts I own. Will prepare renewal-risk notes for each.
kevin (ENG): For CS copy: short symptom list to include in outreach: "failed webhook callback during onboarding, resulting in stuck provisioning; UI shows 'waiting for callback' or tenant appears inactive."
talia (CS): Added a tiny feedback form for affected customers to capture severity and impact: https://forms.redwood-inference.com/onboard-incident-feedback (short, 4 questions). Please forward to anyone you speak with.
maria (CS): Also ask customers if they attempted manual webhook replay — capture that as it helps prioritization.
sam (PLATFORM): I'll export retry logs and attach to internal incident ticket INC-17175. Command:```./logs/export --id INC-17175 --type webhook --since 2024-06-03T09:00Z > /tmp/webhook-retries.csv```
ops-bot: Incident INC-17175: mitigation applied, monitoring.
kevin (ENG): Action items for ENG: verify all requeues completed, add alert for cert rotation validation, add end-to-end test for webhook handshake.
talia (CS): CS action items: send high-touch emails now, run office hours at 16:00, collect feedback form results and escalate any customer asking for credits to @jen. I will paste the high-touch email below shortly.
jen (SALES): Sounds good. Please ping me the affected list asap so we can update deal notes.
talia (CS): Quick external status we will send: "We experienced intermittent onboarding interruptions for a small number of customers between 09:12–09:35 UTC due to an internal certificate validation issue affecting webhook callbacks. We deployed a fix at 09:35 UTC and are retrying pending callbacks; most onboards have completed. If your onboarding remains incomplete, please join our office hours or reply to this thread and we will prioritize you. We apologize for the inconvenience and will share a full RCA in 48 hours."
maria (CS): +1 — include contact link and office hours times.
kevin (ENG): Logged ENG-3842 for permanent fix; ETA sprint 43.
talia (CS): Closing note: timeline — immediate outreach, office hours 16:00 UTC, RCA draft in 48h, final RCA + credits plan in 5 business days. Marking this thread as the single source for customer-facing wording.
jen (SALES): Thanks everyone — will coordinate credits approvals if needed.
ops-bot: Incident INC-17175 status: monitoring stable. Will post updates to status.redwood.ai if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
talia (CS): Thanks all — will update Slack thread with sent emails and any replies. :thumbsup:
